Settings.Title: Settings
Settings.SettingsProfileTooltip: Back up the current Cheats, Hotkeys and Weapon Mod boost values in your user profile and restore them later, even after reinstalling the game or the mod. Favorites are not included and keep working as they always have.
Settings.DestroyTargetTooltip: Deletes the object you are currently looking at. This can remove world objects, invisible barriers, or important level parts. Use carefully.
Settings.DestroyLastSpawnedTooltip: Destroys the actor(s) created by your most recent Spawn/Force action.
Settings.DestroyNearbySpawnedTooltip: Destroys any previously spawned items within a small radius around you.
Settings.FastPlayerActionsTooltip: Speeds up skill, attack, and evade animations. Re-press after changing areas.
Settings.BoostWeaponModsTooltip:
Boosts damage, duration, and charges on your currently equipped weapon mods. Safe to use repeatedly.

Each field is a multiplier on the mod's base value — e.g. 10 means 10x. Exception: "...Frequency" and "...Delay" fields are time intervals, so a higher number makes them trigger less often. Use a value below 1 for those if you want more frequent triggers.
Settings.InfiniteHealthTooltip: God Mode: zeroes all incoming damage before it is applied.
Settings.NoFallDamageTooltip: Works most of the time but hasn't been fully tested yet — you may occasionally still take fall damage.
Settings.EnemyOutlineTooltip: Outlines every living enemy in red, like the Hunter's Mark, at any range and through walls. Only you see it.
Settings.SetAllWeaponLevelTooltip: Sets every equipped weapon to this level. 232 is the highest level currently known to have any effect in-game — higher values are not expected to go further.
Main.SummonTraitTooltip: Uses SummonTrait. Spawn one trait, pick it up, then spawn the next one.
Main.AddTraitTooltip: Uses AddTrait. Adds the trait directly through the Summonable Traits mod.
Main.AddPrismTooltip: Uses AddPrism. Puts the prism straight into your inventory. Prisms you already have are skipped.
Main.UpdateTooltip: Click to download and install the update
Main.MissingOnlyTooltip: Show only weapons, armor, accessories, mutators and relics that aren't in your inventory yet. Needs an inventory scan from the game.
Main.ScanInventoryTooltip: Read your in-game inventory now. While a character is loaded it is also rescanned automatically every few seconds.
Main.SpawnMissingTooltip: Spawn one of every item that isn't in your inventory yet: from the selected subcategory, or from all tracked items under All.
Main.CollectionNoScan: No inventory scan yet. Load a character in-game with the mod running.
Main.CollectionUntracked: {0} is not tracked. Only weapons, armor, accessories, mutators and relics are.
Main.ContentFilterTooltip: Show items from the base game or from one DLC. The collection counts and Spawn Missing follow this filter too.
Main.LastScanStale: Last scan {0} (not live: game closed or not in-game)
Sync.OutdatedGameRunning: {0} mod file(s) in the game folder don't match this app version. Update them now and restart the game afterwards.
Sync.Updated: Mod files updated to match this app version.
Sync.UpdatedRestartGame: Mod files updated. Restart the game to load them.
Sync.Failed: Some mod files couldn't be updated. Details are in the app log.
Sync.FailedAccessDenied: Windows denied access to the game folder. Run the setup to repair it (it can restart the app as administrator).
Install.Title: Install Remnant 2 Unlocker
Install.Intro: Install the app to a fixed folder so it doesn't depend on where you unpacked the download. Updates install into the same folder automatically. You can also keep running it from where it is.
Install.ExistingInstall: Remnant 2 Unlocker is already installed here. It will be updated to this version.
Install.InvalidFolder: Choose a full folder path, e.g. C:\Users\You\AppData\Local\Programs\Remnant2Unlocker.
Install.AccessDenied: Windows denied access to this folder. Choose a folder in your user profile (like the suggested one).
Install.InUse: The app in this folder is still running. Close it and try again.
Settings.InstallationHint: Checks the game folder and installs or repairs everything the mod needs: UE4SS and Allow Asset Mods, the Remnant2Unlocker mod files, stack size support and the mods.txt entries.
Wizard.Title: Set up Remnant 2 Unlocker
Wizard.GameIntro: First, pick your Remnant 2 install. The app installs the mod into this folder and talks to the game through it.
Wizard.Searching: Searching Steam, Epic and Game Pass…
Wizard.NoneFound: No install found automatically. Choose the folder below.
Wizard.GameInvalid: This folder doesn't contain Remnant2-Win64-Shipping.exe or Remnant2-WinGDK-Shipping.exe.
Wizard.GameHint: Steam/Epic: …\Remnant2\Binaries\Win64. Game Pass: …\Remnant 2\Content\Remnant2\Binaries\WinGDK. Choosing the game's main folder works too.
Wizard.BrowseDescription: Select the Remnant 2 folder (the game folder or Binaries\Win64 / Binaries\WinGDK)
Wizard.CloseGameText: The game only reads mod files when it starts, and some files can't be replaced while it runs. Close the game; setup continues on its own.
Wizard.WaitingForGameClose: Waiting for the game to close…
Wizard.CloseGameFirst: Close Remnant 2 first, then try again.
Wizard.ComponentsIntro: Everything the mod needs. Parts marked ↻ are installed by Install / Repair. The Nexus download has to be downloaded by you: open the page, download the main file, then drop it here.
Wizard.CompAmmDesc: The mod loader. Download the main file from Nexus Mods (AMM.zip) and drop it here; the app puts everything in place.
Wizard.CompModDesc: The in-game half of this app. Its files are built into the app and kept up to date automatically.
Wizard.CompSummonDesc: Replaces UE4SS's summon command with one that understands stack size and item level. Without it, items still spawn, one at a time at level 0.
Wizard.CompTraitsDesc: Only needed to spawn Trait and Archetype Trait items.
Wizard.CompEnabledDesc: UE4SS only loads mods that are switched on in Mods\mods.txt. Other mods' lines are left alone.
Wizard.StatusModNotInstalled: Not installed yet: installed by Install / Repair
Wizard.StatusModOutdated: {0} file(s) out of date: updated by Install / Repair
Wizard.StatusSummonPending: Not applied yet: applied by Install / Repair
Wizard.DropHere: Drop the downloaded .zip, .rar or .7z here (or an extracted folder).
Wizard.InstallRepairHint: Installs or updates the parts marked ↻. Replaced files are backed up first.
Wizard.RestoreConfirm: Put back the files from the most recent backup? Files that were added since then are not removed.
Wizard.RestoreNone: There is no backup to restore.
Wizard.RestoreDone: Restored {0} file(s) from the latest backup.
Wizard.ExtraFiles: {0} extra file(s) in the mod's Scripts folder were left as they are.
Wizard.InstallFailed: {0} file(s) could not be written. Details are in the app log.
Wizard.AccessDenied: Windows denied access to the game folder (common for games under C:\Program Files). Restart the app as administrator to install.
Wizard.PackageModSynced: Remnant2Unlocker mod and summon patch: {0} file(s) written.
Wizard.LegacyXinput: Found xinput1_3.dll from an older UE4SS version. The Nexus page says to delete it, so both versions don't load at once.
Wizard.SyncAfterPackageFailed: The mod files couldn't be updated afterwards; click Install / Repair.
Wizard.PackageError.NotFound: The file or folder was not found.
Wizard.PackageError.UnsupportedFormat: Unsupported file type. Use the .zip, .rar or .7z from Nexus, or extract it and choose the folder.
Wizard.PackageError.ExtractFailed: The archive could not be extracted. Extract it yourself and choose the folder instead.
Wizard.PackageError.NotAllowAssetMods: This doesn't look like Allow Asset Mods (expected UE4SS.dll and AllowModsMod).
Wizard.PackageError.AllowModsModWithoutU: This download only contains AllowModsMod, and UE4SS is not installed. Download the main "Allow Asset Mods" file (AMM.zip), which includes UE4SS.
Wizard.PackageError.NotSummonableTraits: This doesn't look like Summonable Traits (no main.lua with SummonTrait/AddTrait found).
Wizard.PackageError.LooksLikeSummonableT: This looks like Summonable Traits. Drop it on the Summonable Traits step.
Wizard.PackageError.LooksLikeAllowAssetM: This looks like Allow Asset Mods. Drop it on the UE4SS + AllowModsMod step.
Wizard.PackageError.AccessDenied: Windows denied access to the game folder (common for games under C:\Program Files). Restart the app as administrator to install.
Wizard.PackageError.VerifyFailed: The files are not there after copying. Your antivirus may have removed them.
Wizard.AntivirusIntro: Antivirus programs, Windows Defender included, sometimes quarantine UE4SS right after it's copied, because it hooks into the game. Checking that it's still there…
Wizard.AntivirusRemovedTitle: UE4SS was removed again, most likely by your antivirus
Wizard.AntivirusRemovedText: Open Windows Security → Virus & threat protection → Protection history, restore the quarantined file(s), and add an exclusion for the game's Binaries folder. Then drop the Allow Asset Mods download again on the previous page, or click Check again.
Wizard.TestIntro: Last step: start the game once to confirm everything works. The app waits until the mod reports in (up to 3 minutes). You don't have to load a character.
Wizard.TestWaiting: Waiting for the game to start…
Wizard.TestModLoaded: UE4SS loaded the mod. Waiting for the bridge…
Wizard.TestConnected: ✓ Bridge connected. The app can talk to the game.
Wizard.TestTimedOut: The mod didn't report in within 3 minutes. If the game is still loading, wait and use Diagnostics later; otherwise open Diagnostics (main window) to see what's missing. You can finish setup anyway.
Wizard.DoneText: You can open this setup again at any time from Settings → Repair / update installation. After an app update, the mod files in the game are updated automatically on the next start.
